files.description: The tree's format version and where the client reference data is
files.name: content

files.description: Numbers the game runs on that aren't any one record's (regeneration, drop rates, levels ...)
files.name: tunables

files.description: The features records can belong to beyond live, feature and other: titles, comments, what each was copied from
files.name: features

kinds.description: A playfield: `worlds/<playfield>-<slug>/world.json`.
kinds.title: World

kinds.description: One thing placed in a world: `worlds/<world>/spawns.json`.
kinds.title: Spawn

kinds.description: A portal: `worlds/<world>/portals.json`.
kinds.title: Portal

kinds.description: A jump pad placed in a world: `worlds/<world>/bouncers.json`.
kinds.title: Bouncer

kinds.description: A named area or point: `worlds/<world>/areas.json`.
kinds.title: Area

kinds.description: A trigger: `worlds/<world>/triggers.json`.
kinds.title: Trigger

kinds.description: A puzzle the server runs: `worlds/<world>/puzzles.json`.
kinds.title: Puzzle

kinds.description:
A scripted event: `worlds/<world>/scripts/<slug>.json`. Its waves spawn the spawns that
name them.
kinds.title: Script

kinds.description: Several worlds that share their minifigure drops ("Pirate World").
kinds.title: Region

kinds.description: An NPC or enemy: `npcs/<slug>.json`.
kinds.title: NPC

kinds.description: Who fights whom: `factions/<slug>.json`.
kinds.title: Faction

kinds.description: A kind of object: `objects/<slug>.json`.
kinds.title: Object

kinds.description: A skill (ability, attack, nano): `skills/<slug>.json`.
kinds.title: Skill

kinds.description: A buff, debuff, upgrade or passive: `buffs/<slug>.json`.
kinds.title: Buff

kinds.description: A loot table (several enemies or objects can share one): `loot/<slug>.json`.
kinds.title: Loot table

kinds.description: An item: `items/<slug>.json`.
kinds.title: Item

kinds.description:
A playable minifigure: `minifigures/<slug>.json`. New ones need client patches (the
collection comes from the client's data); their numbers are free to change.
kinds.title: Minifigure

kinds.description: An NPC dialogue: `dialogues/<slug>.json`. Its lines are client text ids (`texts.json`).
kinds.title: Dialogue

kinds.description:
An achievement (the client's lore tree), or a rule-only key (`category:`, `drop:`,
`find:`): `achievements/<slug>.json`.
kinds.title: Achievement

kinds.description:
A main quest (the client's quest giver list, RDB 1000104): a world's story line or an
area quest, its quests in order (`steps`) and their goals: `quests/<slug>.json`.
kinds.title: Quest

kinds.description:
A Lost Creations level (docs/LOST-CREATIONS.md): `lost-creations/<slug>.json`. Its world
holds the gates, button, exit door and `Start`/`End` areas the ids name.
kinds.title: Lost Creations level
